Business Analyst | Stakeholder Management | Client Relationship Management

Vʌ□V   ayshudevi99@gmail.com | _□ˆ +61 8608078536

³    LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/in/ayshwaryaa-nagamanickam-568221183

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Business Analyst with 6 years of experience in Banking and Financial Services, specializing in requirements analysis, stakeholder management, process improvement, data governance, and Agile delivery. Proven track record of translating complex business requirements into scalable technology solutions that enhance operational efficiency, data quality, and business performance. Experienced in leading cross-functional collaboration, UAT execution, process modeling, and enterprise transformation initiatives within large-scale banking environments.

KEY SKILLS

Business Analysis • Requirements Gathering • Stakeholder Management • Gap Analysis • Business Process Improvement

BRD/FSD Documentation • User Stories s Backlog Management • Data Analysis • Data Mapping • UAT Testing

Agile Scrum • SDLC • Jira • Confluence • SQL • Power BI • Process Modeling • Data Governance • Risk Management

Cross-Functional Collaboration • Banking Domain • Client Relationship Management

TOOLS s TECHNOLOGIES

Jira | Confluence | SQL | Power BI | Excel | Python | Agile Scrum | Word | PowerPoint

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Business Analyst | Virtusa Consulting Services

Client: Citibank, UK | Oracle Ledger Transformation Program

Duration: Jan 2021 – Present

Project Overview

The Oracle Ledger Transformation Program was a strategic banking transformation initiative focused on centralizing accounting rules into a finance-owned Oracle Accounting Hub. The program enhanced data quality, governance, operational efficiency, and financial reporting consistency by standardizing accounting processes across multiple source systems and downstream applications.

Key Responsibilities s Achievements

Collaborated with business stakeholders, product owners, technology teams, and downstream application owners to elicit, analyze, and document business, functional, and data requirements.

Authored and maintained key project artifacts, including Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), process flows, use cases, data mapping documents, and technical design specifications.

Conducted detailed gap analysis to assess current-state (As-Is) and future-state (To-Be) processes, identifying opportunities for process optimization and operational improvements.

Facilitated requirements walkthroughs, validation sessions, and stakeholder reviews to ensure completeness, accuracy, and formal sign-off of deliverables.

Served as the primary liaison between business users, development teams, QA teams, and external stakeholders throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Worked closely with developers during development and unit testing phases to clarify requirements, validate functionality, and ensure alignment with business expectations.

Managed and tracked project activities through Jira, including user stories, defects, change requests, and sprint progress within an Agile delivery framework.



Prepared and executed User Acceptance Testing (UAT) strategies, including test scenarios, test cases, test data preparation, defect tracking, and validation of test results.

Reviewed and validated developer unit testing outcomes and collaborated with testing teams to identify, analyze, and resolve functional gaps and defects.

Performed comprehensive data analysis, data mapping, attribute mapping, and reconciliation activities across multiple upstream and downstream systems.

Conducted data quality assessments, data governance reviews, and post-implementation validations to ensure data integrity and compliance with business standards.

Monitored and tracked daily data copy activities across multiple dimensions, maintaining status updates and operational documentation in Confluence.

Prepared and presented weekly project status reports, progress updates, risk assessments, and executive-level summaries to stakeholders and project leadership.

Developed detailed process diagrams, workflow models, system interaction flows, and business process maps using industry-standard documentation practices.

Coordinated with upstream and downstream application teams to resolve functional, technical, and data-related queries, ensuring seamless integration and delivery.

Took ownership of access management activities, including application onboarding, server access provisioning, query entitlements, endpoint configurations, and environment setup.

Managed and maintained application metadata, SLA information, file specifications, attribute definitions, business rules, and integration details within enterprise data governance platforms such as Maphub.

Designed and standardized Common Intake Templates across multiple dimensions to facilitate outbound file generation and streamline downstream consumer onboarding processes.

Supported Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, requirement refinement sessions, and retrospectives.

Partnered with cross-functional teams to drive issue resolution, risk mitigation, dependency management, and successful project execution from inception through deployment.

Parent Relationship Manager | Vedantu Duration: Jun 2020– Dec 2020 (6 Months)

Project Overview

Managed parent and student relationships to ensure a seamless learning experience by addressing concerns, coordinating with academic and operational teams, and driving customer engagement initiatives. Acted as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, facilitating effective communication, issue resolution, and service delivery while contributing to customer satisfaction and retention objectives.

Key Responsibilities s Achievements

Served as the primary point of contact for parents and students, addressing academic, operational, and service-related inquiries.

Built and maintained strong relationships with stakeholders through proactive communication and timely issue resolution.

Collaborated with academic counsellors, teachers, and internal support teams to ensure a positive learning experience for students.

Conducted regular follow-ups with parents to monitor student engagement, progress, and satisfaction levels.

Identified customer concerns and coordinated with relevant teams to implement effective resolutions within defined timelines.

Maintained accurate records of customer interactions, feedback, escalations, and resolutions using internal systems.

Analysed customer feedback and provided insights to improve service quality, operational processes, and customer experience.



Supported student retention initiatives by understanding customer needs and recommending appropriate educational solutions.

Facilitated communication between parents and academic teams to ensure alignment on student performance and learning goals.

Assisted in managing escalations, ensuring prompt resolution while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

Contributed to achieving customer engagement, retention, and service excellence targets through consistent stakeholder management.

Participated in team meetings, process improvement discussions, and customer experience enhancement initiatives.

AWARDS AND RECOGNITION

The Highflyer Award (FY-26) – Recognized for outstanding performance and exceptional contribution to business objectives.

Long Service Award (May 2026) – Honoured for completing 5 years of dedicated service at Virtusa, demonstrating commitment, consistency, and excellence in delivery.

Top Talent – BFS Major Accounts (2023) – Awarded for significant contributions to high-priority banking transformation programs.

Best Employee of the Month – Recognized for consistently exceeding performance expectations.

Spot Award – September 2023 – Awarded for exceptional project execution and stakeholder satisfaction.

Spot Award – April 2024 – Recognized for driving successful project outcomes and operational excellence.

CERTIFICATIONS

Oracle Certified Java Associate Professional (OCJAP)

Business Analysis Masterclass – Udemy

Agile Methodologies Certification – Udemy

Power BI Masterclass – Udemy

Complete Python Bootcamp – Udemy

Introduction to Generative AI (GenAI) – Udemy

EDUCATION

Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Finance

Annamalai University | 2021 – 2023

CGPA: 7.91/10

Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) – Computer Science & Engineering

Knowledge Institute of Technology | 2016 – 2020

CGPA: 7.73/10

Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC)

Jayarani Girls Higher Secondary School | 2015 – 2016

Percentage: 88%

AWARDS AND RECOGNITION
The Highflyer Award (FY-26) – Recognized for outstanding performance and exceptional contribution to business objectives.
Long Service Award (May 2026) – Honoured for completing 5 years of dedicated service at Virtusa, demonstrating commitment, consistency, and excellence in delivery.
Top Talent – BFS Major Accounts (2023) – Awarded for significant contributions to high-priority banking transformation programs.
Best Employee of the Month – Recognized for consistently exceeding performance expectations.
Spot Award – September 2023 – Awarded for exceptional project execution and stakeholder satisfaction.
Spot Award – April 2024 – Recognized for driving successful project outcomes and operational excellence.
